svg.text: PALRAM9B: Unified E0 + E2-E7 with REP OUTSB
— shared by both palettes, completes within HBLANK (~55 cy)
— zeros, spill past HBLANK is harmless
— passthrough: same value rewritten, no flicker
— pre-loaded with line N+2 colors, safe in any column
FLIP + OPEN(0x40) + PUSH CX + REP OUTSB×16 + POP CX + CLOSE
Active (Pal 0) — passthrough: same value rewritten — no flicker
Inactive (Pal 1) — pre-loaded with line N+2 colors — safe in any column
PALRAM9B vs BMP4: What Changed in the Stream
OPEN at 0x44 → stream 12 bytes (E2-E7 only) → CLOSE. Image only, no raster bars.
OPEN at 0x40 → REP OUTSB 16 bytes (E0 + E1 + E2-E7) → CLOSE. Image + raster bars unified.
E0 (bar color) completes at ~55 cycles — within the ~72-80 cycle HBLANK window. CGA palette flip 100% stable.
Not used in CGA mode 4. Written as zeros. Spill past HBLANK is harmless — no pixels reference E1.
Tiny left-edge glitch on bar scanlines only (E0 write at ~55 cy borderline). Cannot be eliminated.
Olivetti Prodest PC1 · Yamaha V6355D · NEC V40 @ 8 MHz · CGA Mode 4 · Unified E0+E2-E7 REP OUTSB — confirmed on real hardware (March 2026)
